theme: An open Saturday — tomorrow's review is the only fixed point.
greeting: Clear calendar today, Dan, with the girls still in St. Pete before tomorrow's handoff. A light day — the real work is teeing up the Sunday review and keeping the Christmas-travel bookings from sliding another week.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike, 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute board triage — empty the inbox, put an owner and date on everything, kill what's slipped three Sundays running. A few minutes on the 'Dan & Mike Stuff' board tonight makes it quick.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out. This p1 has been open since mid-September; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: December destination call
needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and the book-by date is Oct 15. With passports landing in November, the clean path is a domestic shortlist — pick that or commit to refundable-only international, and retire the Dec 13 St Pete cycle.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete drive window opens Oct 5, two days out. Set the two dates and book the single hotel night so the off-week gap doesn't slip past.

flagged.title: Apple sign-in alert worth a look
flagged.detail: An 'AppleCare One: Action required' notice says a new Apple Account signed in to an iPhone. Verify through Apple directly rather than the email link before doing anything.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message waiting
flagged.detail: Hans-Kristian messaged you on LinkedIn and it's still unanswered — worth a glance given the board search.

flagged.title: Valoris Catalysts Teams invite
flagged.detail: A meeting invite to you, Martin, Davit and Mike from Valoris. Put it on the calendar if you haven't already.

flagged.title: ICGN panel bio
flagged.detail: Drew sent notes back on your ICGN Toronto bio and the LinkedIn announcement — your move to finalize it.

flagged.title: Oct 25 DIRA/DIBA materials
flagged.detail: David Wetherbee sent the packet for the Oct 25 meeting; review it ahead of time.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts, and app notifications.

recipe.title: Roast chicken smothered with chanterelles
recipe.why: Autumn is peak chanterelle season, and cool afternoons make roasting a whole bird a pleasure again.

acts.line: A clear Saturday — the calendar's empty and the girls are home in St. Pete.
No meetings to break up the day, the kind of open stretch that's rare midweek.
A quiet close before tomorrow's handoff, when the girls head back to Jen's around six.
